note: Hikers Canyon campground in Sulphur Gates PRA, 5 km north and 7 km west of Grande Cache off Hwy 40, near the Sulphur/Smoky River confluence: spur sites around a gravel parking area, with a short trail to lookout platforms over the Sulphur River canyon. Saddle Ridge Equestrian Campground is a short distance down the road. The road is not maintained in winter. --Claude
summary: Camping page (updated Oct 16, 2026) read: 11 unserviced FCFS sites now C$25 (was 30), year-round, vault toilets, hand-pump water not safe to drink. Pin moves ~310 m south to the Hikers Canyon lot. The agency calls the sites 'suitable for tents' (criteria flag).
flags: CRITERIA (RV fit, for the reviewer): the page says 'There are 11 unserviced campsites suitable for tents.' The tear sheet (Jan 2024) and Esri imagery show the 11 sites as spurs around a gravel parking area at the south end of the access road, vehicles parked in them; a Google review (2 months ago) mentions 'drive through parking', another 'It's all gravel so not ideal for tent camping', another 'Sites are small, close together'. No agency text bars RVs. The stored inclusion evidence quoted an aggregator's 'tents, RVs, equestrian'. Keep unless the reviewer reads 'suitable for tents' as tent-only.

ROAD: page says 'The road is not maintained in winter.' (not a closure or a 4WD/RV warning). A Google reviewer wrote 'Gavel road to the campground, washed out in sections at times' (a camper, not the agency; reported only).

PROVINCIAL PAGE LINES: Information phone 780-827-7393 (matches stored). Seniors-discount line PRESENT ('This campground qualifies for the camping fee discount for Alberta seniors.'). No 'Facility Operator' line. No advisories. Not on the shop (first come only).
PIN MOVE: 53.85290,-119.18565 sits ~310 m north on the access road by the staging/equestrian area. Move to the Hikers Canyon lot at the agency directions point 53.85013,-119.18618.
GOOGLE: 'Sulphur Gates Campground' 4.2 stars, 15 reviews (a review two months ago mentions '$30 per night self serve'; the agency page now says $25).
